purpose: Define the schema for a future independently reviewed commercial-shell comparison. This file does not instantiate or select a product, element, comparison case or mesh.

instantiation.blocker: Repository context does not select a licensed external solver/product or supply the exact comparison case and mesh decisions required by WP-004 task 6.
instantiation.unblockCriteria: A separately reviewed instantiated revision must fill every required external decision and approve acceptance quantities and tolerances before any candidate implementation or commercial result is generated, viewed, imported or inspected.
instantiation.prohibitedInference: Do not invent, infer or choose missing external values from repository context or after observing candidate results.

nonClaims: A commercial-shell comparison is not an analytical proof of the kernel.
Mesh convergence does not make a commercial result exact.
This protocol does not establish Eurocode or UK National Annex compliance.

caseFreeze.changeRule: Any change after pre-run approval creates a new case revision; do not overwrite or silently amend the approved case.

softwareAndSolver.deviationRule: A different analysis regime requires a separately approved comparison case and rationale.

compatibilityReview: State whether the element is Reissner-Mindlin, Kirchhoff-Love or another shell theory.
State whether transverse shear is included and how locking is controlled.
State all stabilization and report available stabilization energies or forces.
Do not select an element only because its output happens to agree with the app.

unitsAndAxes.mappingProofRequired: Demonstrate each raw-to-ADR sign and axis mapping with a documented unit load or other independently reviewable sign check before comparison outputs are interpreted.

geometry.constructionRule: Create the shell midsurface from the same four physical global vertices and vertex order as the approved app fixture; do not recreate geometry from a screenshot or nominal angle alone.
geometry.obliqueAxisRule: Oblique s/t geometry directions are not tensor axes unless an explicit orthonormal tensor transformation is supplied and reviewed.

consistencyChecks: Record whether shear modulus is computed from E and nu or entered independently.
Record whether density, self-weight, thermal strain or other unintended action is active.
Record section orientation and all through-thickness integration points.

supportsAndRigidBodyControl.plateEquivalenceRule: On each physical clamped plate support line restrain transverse translation and the two bending rotations required by the approved plate case. Do not automatically restrain all six shell DOFs.
supportsAndRigidBodyControl.membraneRigidBodyRule: Because the app plate has no in-plane DOFs, leave shell in-plane translations free except for the minimum geometrically frozen constraints needed to remove rigid membrane modes.
supportsAndRigidBodyControl.prohibitedShortcut: Fully fixing every commercial shell DOF on an edge without demonstrating equivalence to the plate case.

loads.pressureRule: Preserve the approved pressure after geometric clipping. Do not renormalize to recover gross patch force unless the approved case explicitly requires it.
loads.loadAudit: Integrate commercial applied nodal or surface loads independently and compare the signed force and moments with the approved clipped polygon before solving.

meshFamilies.freezeRule: All levels, refinements and extraction stations are approved before results. Do not add a mesh level solely to obtain a desired comparison.
meshFamilies.comparisonRule: Use one systematic family with comparable geometry and loading rather than unrelated hand-tuned meshes.

extraction.singularityRule: Do not use a known singular corner or discontinuity for pointwise acceptance unless singular behaviour is the explicit purpose of the case.
extraction.rawDataRule: Retain unaveraged integration-point or section-cut data alongside any processed display value.

equilibrium.reportingRule: Report signed applied, support and residual totals and the individual action terms used to calculate each total.
equilibrium.normalizationRule: If normalized residuals are later approved, retain the dimensional signed residuals and freeze the denominator before results.

contractDeviationRule: No run or result generation, viewing, import or inspection is permitted while this template is uninstantiated or before CS-PRE-04 passes. Any result, changed tolerance, mesh, station, restraint, load or mapping introduced before the applicable gate requires a new controlled revision and independent disposition.
